notes.title: New Platform Release & New Game Title Announcement
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32004068/b8ea8f385a566df5f47bc964bba97201564438d5.jpg[/img]

After releasing Azure Saga: Pathfinder on Switch a year ago, we finally expand the title to the iOS platform just today.

For those interested you can go to this link:
[url=https://apps.apple.com/us/app/azure-saga-pathfinder/id1093016229]Azure Saga: Pathfinder - iOS[/url]

Besides that, we also have an important announcement on our newest project which currently developed called [b]Potion Permit[/b] that will be released by 2021! Don't forget to wishlist the product if it is interest you! 
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1337760/Potion_Permit/

And here is the trailer of the game:
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=3WvP403k63A

To follow the progress of our small studio including some news regarding our newest project, we recommend and invite you to come along and follow our social media account :
[url=https://discord.gg/r9fYWXv]MassHive Media Discord[/url]
[url=https://twitter.com/MasshiveMedia]MassHive Media Twitter[/url]
[url=https://twitter.com/PotionPermit]Potion Permit Twitter[/url]

Thank you so much for your attention & support. We hope we might be able to see you on our social media accounts for our further updates! ːsteamhappyː

notes.title: "Indienesia" Bundle for Indonesia's Special Month
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32004068/c4558b7b923b646b1553e2e4ddf7985af1564f12.png[/img]

Azure Saga: Pathfinder is taking part in the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/7880/Indienesia_Bundle__Games_Made_in_Indonesia/] Indienesia Bundle [/url]  in celebration of both Indonesia’s Independence Day and National Game Day.

The bundle consists of games from various genres crafted by independent game developer in Indonesia; from survival horror, roguelike tower defense, twisted alchemist simulator, as well as classic and modern takes on the JRPG genre.

Simply click on this [url=https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/7880/Indienesia_Bundle__Games_Made_in_Indonesia/] link [/url]  to check out the bundle.

Hi everyone ːsteamhappyː, we wanted to update you that Azure Saga:Pathfinder will be coming soon, we couldn't say the exact date but rest assured it will be very soon ːPinkContentː

We will be having a couple of PINNED discussion once the game is live,
so make sure to get into discussion page once it's live. The PINNED discussion will include the following:

- BUG / Glitch Issues / Known Issues
- Patch Updates

And of course feel free to discuss what you like about the game !
See you guys soon !
